notes.title: GIFT TO HUMANITY: Update Live
notes.notes:
The latest update is now live with the following changes:

Phase-Shift: The game just got a lot faster with phase-shift, allowing you to teleport of all over the place.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/d686d1473ab0410a30655d14cf5bf0b715f7d404.png

Vital Areas: Head shots now deal additional damage to enemies.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/40b92dbef1ac9a89e4ca3025ee378f71be8ba194.png

AI Update: AI will now behave more realistically and patrol the map while out of combat.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Third Person | Campaign | AI | Co-op | Arena
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/e9591ca3122a702451bd51be2d3c04ad911fcbba.png

On player demand Gift To Humanity was reworked and converted from a top-down to third-person shooter putting you right in the action.

Campaign: Chapter 2 has been finalized and is now fully playable which includes new enemies, skills, gear and some more pieces of the puzzle.

AI Update: Converting the game from top-down to third-person required an complete rework of AI.

Co-op: On request co-op has been added and is now available for public beta testing. You can now enjoy the campaign with your friends.

Arena: With co-op making its way into the game I decided to add arena as a bonus. Here you can challenge your friends to a game of wits and skills.

I hope you enjoy the changes, and I'm looking forward to your feedback on how I can improve.

Regards
Ultima Games

notes.title: UPDATE: 1.1.3.8 Auto-Level
notes.notes:
Auto-level unlocks skills and allocates specialty-points according to an easy to play beginner’s build giving new players the opportunity to jump straight into the action.

Completing the tutorial is still recommended but the auto level gives new players the chance to only worry about combat and gives them a good basic build to work off.

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE : BOTS + SINGEPLAYER
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26290849/a001b0c603c585a35120156637030ce08a8fcd66.png

Whats New?
-	Bots are now available on all maps.
-	Bots can be added to multiplayer games to fill matches.
-	Single player where you can practice/play against bots.
-	Bots now use a wide variety of skills and builds.
-	Major bug fixes to bots


In The Works?
-	Conquest: Only a concept at the moment but in this game mode players will be able to compete on their own time. Hire bots and build your own team to take over territory from other players and deploy forces to defend them.

-	Classes: The game was originally designed with 3 concept classes Tactical, Support and Demolition. Currently only tactical is available in-game but support and demolition might find their way into the game in the future.
